name: The Smiths

whyMatters.en: Manchester four-piece, 1982–1987. Morrissey lyric and Johnny Marr multi-tracked jangle on Rough Trade; Meat Is Murder hit UK No. 1; The Queen Is Dead (1986) is the peak album citation.
whyMatters.zh: 曼彻斯特四人组，1982–1987。Rough Trade 上 Morrissey 歌词与 Johnny Marr 多层 jangle；《Meat Is Murder》英国榜冠军；《The Queen Is Dead》（1986）是峰值专辑引用。

note.zh: 早期 Rough Trade 突破单曲；Rickenbacker jangle 与跳拍鼓 intro。

note.zh: 收录于《Hatful of Hollow》；双吉他 vibrato/tremolo 墙。

shortBio.en: Morrissey / Marr indie, Manchester 1982–1987. Rough Trade; The Queen Is Dead peak; split with no reunion album.
shortBio.zh: Morrissey / Marr 的 indie，曼彻斯特 1982–1987。Rough Trade；《The Queen Is Dead》峰值；解散后无重组专辑。

body.en:
The Smiths formed in Manchester in 1982: Morrissey (Stephen Morrissey), Johnny Marr (John Maher), Andy Rourke (after briefly considering Dale Hibbert), and Mike Joyce (who had briefly followed Simon Wolstencroft, later of The Fall). The plain name contrasted with flashier contemporaries such as Spandau Ballet. Early songs Hand in Glove, What Difference Does It Make?, and Heaven Knows I’m Miserable Now addressed teenage pain.

Debut The Smiths (1984) reached UK No. 2; Suffer Little Children drew controversy over the mid-1960s Moors murders. Meat Is Murder (1985) hit UK No. 1, targeting meat-eaters and cruel headmasters; That Joke Isn’t Funny Anymore missed the Top 40 yet became a catalog staple. The Queen Is Dead (1986) gathered Frankly, Mr. Shankly, Some Girls Are Bigger Than Others, There Is a Light That Never Goes Out, and The Boy with the Thorn in His Side. Strangeways, Here We Come (1987) was the last studio album (Girlfriend in a Coma; I Started Something I Couldn’t Finish). Morrissey and Marr split later that year. Live Rank (1988) and compilations followed; Hatful of Hollow (1984) remains a key set, including How Soon Is Now?.

Morrissey’s solo Viva Hate began three UK No. 1 albums (also Vauxhall and I, 1994; Ringleader of the Tormentors, 2006). Marr later worked with The The, Electronic, Modest Mouse, The Cribs, and Johnny Marr and The Healers. Noel Gallagher later grouped The Beatles, The Smiths, and Sex Pistols as a British music shorthand. Robert Smith of The Cure dismissed them in The Face (1989). Reunion pressure stayed high; Morrissey refused in Uncut (2006).
body.zh:
The Smiths 于 1982 年在曼彻斯特成立：Morrissey（Stephen Morrissey）、Johnny Marr（John Maher）、Andy Rourke（曾短暂考虑 Dale Hibbert 之后招募）、Mike Joyce（曾短暂追随后来加入 The Fall 的 Simon Wolstencroft）。普通队名对照 Spandau Ballet 一类浮夸名称。早期《Hand in Glove》《What Difference Does It Make?》《Heaven Knows I'm Miserable Now》写少年痛楚。

首专《The Smiths》（1984）英国榜第 2；《Suffer Little Children》因 1960 年代中期沼泽谋杀案引发争议。《Meat Is Murder》（1985）英国榜冠军，矛头指向肉食者与残酷校长；《That Joke Isn't Funny Anymore》未进前 40，仍成目录常曲。《The Queen Is Dead》（1986）收《Frankly, Mr. Shankly》《Some Girls Are Bigger Than Others》《There Is a Light That Never Goes Out》《The Boy with the Thorn in His Side》。《Strangeways, Here We Come》（1987）为最后一张录音室专（《Girlfriend in a Coma》《I Started Something I Couldn't Finish》）。同年稍晚 Morrissey 与 Marr 分道。现场《Rank》（1988）与多张合辑随后；《Hatful of Hollow》（1984）仍是重要选辑，含《How Soon Is Now?》。

Morrissey 个人首专《Viva Hate》开启三张英国冠军专（另有《Vauxhall and I》1994、《Ringleader of the Tormentors》2006）。Marr 后合作 The The、Electronic、Modest Mouse、The Cribs 及 Johnny Marr and The Healers。Noel Gallagher 后来把 The Beatles、The Smiths、Sex Pistols 并列为英国音乐缩影。The Cure 的 Robert Smith 在《The Face》（1989）贬斥他们。重组呼声持续；Morrissey 在《Uncut》（2006）明确拒绝。

title.en: Jangle and literary lyric from Manchester
title.zh: 来自曼彻斯特的 jangle 与文学歌词

body.en:
Marr’s textured multi-guitar layers sit under Morrissey’s first-person UK working-class and cultural references, often with dry humor on sex and culture, and anger on vegetarianism and war.

The Queen Is Dead (1986) is the album later Britpop acts name most often.
body.zh:
Marr 质感多层吉他托着 Morrissey 的第一人称英国工薪与文化指涉，性与文化上常有冷幽默，素食与战争议题上带怒意。

《The Queen Is Dead》（1986）是后来 Britpop 最常点名的专辑。

body.en:
1982–87 classic four: Morrissey, Marr, Rourke, Joyce. Craig Gannon appears on the 1986 timeline as additional guitar. Breakup ends the catalog; Rank (1988) is the live coda. No reunion album.

Five studio albums plus Hatful of Hollow carry most citations.
body.zh:
1982–87 经典四人：Morrissey、Marr、Rourke、Joyce。Craig Gannon 出现在 1986 年时间线作额外吉他。解散结束目录；《Rank》（1988）为现场收束。无重组专辑。

五张录音室专加《Hatful of Hollow》承载主要引用。

body.en:
1983 Rough Trade single: skippy drums, bright arpeggios, baritone over a major-key bounce.

Early entry for UK indie guitar radio beside Hand in Glove and Heaven Knows I’m Miserable Now.
body.zh:
1983 年 Rough Trade 单曲：跳拍鼓、明亮分解和弦、大调弹跳上的男中音。

与《Hand in Glove》《Heaven Knows I'm Miserable Now》并列的英国 indie 吉他电台早期入口。

body.en:
1986 album of regret, security longing, and vanished-time nostalgia. Frankly, Mr. Shankly and Some Girls Are Bigger Than Others lean kitchen-sink realism; There Is a Light That Never Goes Out and The Boy with the Thorn in His Side are lasting public entries.

Meat Is Murder (1985) had already taken UK No. 1.
body.zh:
1986 年专辑：悔恨、渴望保障、对消逝时光的留恋。《Frankly, Mr. Shankly》《Some Girls Are Bigger Than Others》偏厨房水槽现实主义；《There Is a Light That Never Goes Out》《The Boy with the Thorn in His Side》是长寿公众入口。

《Meat Is Murder》（1985）已拿下英国榜冠军。

alt.zh: The Smiths，1984 年 Sire 宣传照

body.en:
Division of labor is clear: Marr owns multi-guitar voicings; Morrissey owns lyric and persona. Rourke’s melodic bass and Joyce’s dry kit keep songs short.

How Soon Is Now? stacks vibrato for density while keeping song form; Hatful of Hollow is the key compilation citation.
body.zh:
分工清楚：Marr 管多吉他声部；Morrissey 管词与人设。Rourke 的旋律贝斯与 Joyce 的干鼓保持短曲。

《How Soon Is Now?》用 vibrato 堆密度并保留歌曲形式；《Hatful of Hollow》是关键选辑引用。

title.en: Gallagher praise, Smith scorn, reunion refusal
title.zh: Gallagher 赞、Smith 贬、拒绝重组

body.en:
Noel Gallagher grouped The Smiths with The Beatles and Sex Pistols as a British music shorthand. Robert Smith of The Cure rejected them in The Face (1989). Morrissey’s 2006 Uncut line refused reunion in vegetarian terms.

Quotes sit beside the five studio albums, not instead of them.
body.zh:
Noel Gallagher 把 The Smiths 与 The Beatles、Sex Pistols 并列为英国音乐缩影。The Cure 的 Robert Smith 在《The Face》（1989）否定他们。Morrissey 2006 年《Uncut》以素食者口吻拒绝重组。

引语旁证五张录音室专，不替代唱片。

body.en:
After the split Marr collaborated across The The, Electronic, Modest Mouse, and The Cribs; Morrissey built a solo UK chart career. Oasis and Blur inherit Marr’s voicings and Morrissey’s first-person UK lyric as separate strands.

The Smiths remain a main 1980s hinge into 1990s UK guitar radio.
body.zh:
解散后 Marr 合作 The The、Electronic、Modest Mouse、The Cribs；Morrissey 建立个人英国榜事业。Oasis 与 Blur 分别继承 Marr 的声部与 Morrissey 的第一人称英国歌词。

The Smiths 仍是通向 1990 年代英国吉他电台的主要 1980 年代节点。

note.en: Rough Trade studio core; five albums then Morrissey–Marr split 1987.
note.zh: Rough Trade 录音室核心；五专后 1987 年 Morrissey–Marr 分道。

note.en: Book timeline lists Gannon (b. 1966) around the Queen Is Dead year.
note.zh: 书中时间线在《The Queen Is Dead》年份列出 Gannon（生于 1966）。

note.en: Rough Trade jangle single that fixed an early UK indie guitar sound.
note.zh: 定下早期英国 indie 吉他声音的 Rough Trade jangle 单曲。

note.en: Literary lyric and multi-tracked jangle without synth-pop; Manchester, not London.
note.zh: 文学歌词与多层 jangle，不做 synth-pop；曼彻斯特而非伦敦。
